projects.title: Intern Project - Amazon Oncall Calendar Integration
projects.description:
• [Java, JavaScript] Download Calendar: Added a feature to corporate Amazon Oncall website that allowed clients to download selected on-call schedules into a .ics format to import to personal calendars.
• [Java, JavaScript] User Settings Page: Created a user settings page that contained editable settings to store on DynamoDB.
• [Java, AWS] Continuous Integration: Created AWS step function that retrieves user settings data and sends emails with .ics files to update previously imported calendars.

projects.title: Creative Writing - The 38th Annual Vietnamese Culture Night: "Time in Tides"
projects.description: [Writing] A theater script revolving around cultural assimilation in the Vietnamese American community, written for the largest Vietnamese student production in California, with 145 cast members (song, dance, theater, and logistics groups) and an annual attendance of over 1500.
